overview.description: The SEI QiM U.S. Equity Factor Allocation Active ETF (SEUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in US companies across all market capitalizations. The fund seeks long-term capital growth and income by emphasizing companies with attractive valuations, strong profitability, and positive earnings momentum. SEUS was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by SEI.

holdings.infoBox: SEUS is an equity ETF with a total of 368 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 5.85%, Apple at 5.71%, Microsoft at 4.00%, Alphabet at 3.69%, and Amazon.com at 2.09%.
